title: pinka installer answers
description: Every non-secret choice of the installer TUI, replayed with bootstrap.sh --answers. Records which secrets are generated and which are provided, never their values. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (the device confirmation, disjoint cpusets, unique researchers, at least one admin, the platform tool's source rules) are checked by pinka_installer.answers.

mode.description: fresh: a new lab; restore: provision, then restore a snapshot; modify: change an installed lab.

name.description: Machine name: host_vars file, tailnet host name, fingerprints.

lab_mode.description: production, or staging: a QA lab with its own vault, research space and Tailscale identity (tag:pinka-qa) that never pairs with production.

node_role.description: full: everything on this host; lab: lab services, inference on a paired node; inference: vLLM only (docs/node-roles.md).

provider.description: auto takes the provider from the host profile.

power_policy.description: lab_session_inhibit keeps the host awake while a lab session runs; never_sleep; os_default (always on WSL, where Windows decides).

firewall_backend.description: auto takes the host's active firewall (nftables, firewalld or ufw).

allow_community_repos.description: Allow community package repositories where a component has no official one (the component source matrix).

machine.description: The host: name, role, provider and paths.

expected_memory_gib.description: Memory the host should have (on WSL: memory= of .wslconfig); doctor warns when it differs.

expected_cpu_threads.description: CPU threads the host should have (on WSL: processors= of .wslconfig).

cpuset_services.description: CPUs of the lab services (Linux cpuset list, such as 0-5).

cpuset_targets.description: CPUs of the Incus targets; must not overlap cpuset_services.

postgres_shared_buffers.description: Postgres shared_buffers, such as 2048MB; empty derives it from the memory.

concurrent_targets.description: Targets that run at once (incus_concurrent_targets): they size the bench project's memory and the memory preflight requires.

resources.description: Expected resources and the CPU split between lab services and targets.

source.description: loop: a loop file inside the system; device: a dedicated disk, formatted.

loop_size_gib.description: Size of the loop file (source loop): auto (computed by preflight from the golden images, the concurrent targets' root disks and the free space), or whole GiB, at least 20.

device.description: The pool disk by its /dev/disk/by-id path (source device).

device_confirm.description: Must equal device exactly; the pool disk is formatted only then (safety invariant 1).

force_wipe.description: Wipe a device that carries signatures (typed WIPE confirmation in the TUI).

storage.description: The Incus storage pool of the targets.

admin.description: Member of pinka-admin (sudo on the host); at least one researcher is an admin.

grafana.description: Create a Grafana account (password generated into the vault).

researchers.description: The lab's researchers: Linux accounts, research space directories, Grafana accounts.

researchers_removed.description: Researchers who left: their accounts are locked, their data stays.

tailscale_tag.description: The node's tailnet tag; empty: tag:pinka-lab, or tag:pinka-qa on staging.

tailscale_login.description: auth_key: from PINKA_SECRET_TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY or the TUI; interactive: the login URL is shown during the install.

grafana_tailscale_serve.description: Publish Grafana on the tailnet with tailscale serve (never Funnel).

tailscale_serve_consent.description: On a Tailscale node that was logged in before pinka (an adopted node): consent that pinka adds its tailscale serve entries to it; without it pinka publishes nothing there. Uninstall removes only the entries pinka added. Ignored on a node pinka joins.

ssh_extra_allowed_interfaces.description: Network interfaces besides tailscale0 that accept SSH (not on WSL).

close_listeners.description: On a shared host: the listeners preflight found (tcp/8080, udp/5353) that the firewall closes with your consent; every other one stays reachable as it was. The service keeps running, connections already open stay open, and uninstall makes them reachable again. A port Docker publishes for a container cannot be closed here. A listener that serves the install's access path closes only with that path.

close_install_path.description: Consent to close the install's access path (SSH from outside the tailnet, for example from the LAN) at the end of the run, once a researcher has logged in with a key over the tailnet in the same run. Without the consent or without that login it stays open and doctor warns.

split_inference.description: For node_role lab or inference: the machine name of the other node once paired (docs/node-roles.md); pairing can also come later (pinka pair).

peer.description: Machine name of the paired node.

install_driver.description: install_nvidia_driver: auto (the pinned branch of versions.lock.yml), manual or skip.

accept_mok_enrollment.description: Consent that bootstrap installs the NVIDIA driver and imports a Machine Owner Key on a Secure Boot host (install_driver auto only). Bootstrap reads the one-time MOK password from standard input (--mok-password-stdin); this file never holds it.

vllm_profile.description: A profile of vllm/profiles/; empty: chosen from the GPU.

default_model.description: An id of models.lock.yml, or none (vLLM installed, nothing served).

start_serving.description: Start serving the default model after the install.

gpu.description: NVIDIA driver, vLLM serving profile and default model.

features.description: The feature switches: a switched-off feature is not installed and counts nothing in the requirements. host_vars: inference and training.

inference.description: auto: vLLM, its images and the default model where the host has a usable GPU (gpu_inference) on a full or inference node; off: none of them. An inference node needs auto.

training.description: auto: training jobs where the host has a usable GPU (gpu_training), on a full node; cpu: also the jobs' CPU-only variant without one; off: the GPU arbiter refuses every run.

repository.description: The restic repository by type: sftp (host, user, path), rest (url), local (path; not a real backup) or later (doctor warns until it is set).

password.description: The restic password: generated (shown once) or provided (PINKA_SECRET_RESTIC_PASSWORD).

include_models.description: Back up model weights too (large; they can be downloaded again).

pg_dumps_kept.description: Local PostgreSQL dumps kept below the research space, one a day (backup_pgdump_keep).

platform.description: The platform release to deploy, or null for a standalone lab without a platform.

content.description: One source per content package the platform's manifest declares, by package name (lower-case letters, digits and '-'). A package from the release's repository must not overlap the release path or another package.

source_trust.description: How the platform's Git sources are trusted.

known_hosts.description: Host key lines of an SSH source other than GitHub (GitHub's come from versions.lock.yml).

require_signed_tags.description: Deploy only tags carrying a valid SSH signature of an allowed signer.

allowed_signers.description: allowed_signers lines (ssh-keygen -Y) of the tag signers.

platform_settings.description: Non-secret settings per service of the platform, checked against the service's config schema when the release is inspected and deployed.

after_boot.description: serve: the default deployment after boot; idle: nothing until asked.

restore_after_training.description: Bring the deployment served before a training run back when the run ends.

training_caps.description: This host's caps on training jobs; the GPU arbiter refuses a run of a job over them.

memory_max.description: A job's memory; auto: computed from the host, MemTotal minus what else runs, 4 to 24 GiB.

dataset_max.description: The size of a published dataset.

run_storage_max.description: A run's output and checkpoints together.

tmp_max.description: A job's /tmp (a tmpfs counted against its memory).

telemetry_retention.description: How long the telemetry stores keep their data; the capacity plan shows the growth they allow.

prometheus.description: Prometheus's retention by time (observability_prometheus_retention), such as 90d.

prometheus_size.description: Prometheus's retention by size (observability_prometheus_retention_size; powers of 2), such as 50GB; 0: by time only.

loki.description: Loki's retention of logs (observability_loki_retention), such as 2160h.

tempo.description: Tempo's retention of traces (observability_tempo_retention), in hours, such as 720h.

generate.description: Service passwords (database roles, Grafana users) are always generated.

hf_token.description: provided (PINKA_SECRET_HF_TOKEN) for gated models, else none.

store_vault_password.description: Keep the vault password root-only in /etc/pinka/secrets/vault-pass.

platform.description: Per secret the platform's manifest names (<service>.<secret>): generate, or provided (PINKA_SECRET_PLATFORM_<SERVICE>_<SECRET>, upper case, other characters as '_').

secrets.description: Which secrets are generated and which are provided (never their values).

hostname.description: Host name: lower-case letters, digits and '-', at most 63 characters.

username.description: Linux user name: lower-case, starting with a letter, not reserved, not pinka-*.

username_any.description: A Linux user name (also one already removed).

cpuset.description: A Linux cpuset list, such as 0-5,8.

source.description: A Git source: repo is an SSH URL (read with the deploy key generated on the host), an anonymous https:// URL or a root-owned file:/// repository, never a URL with credentials; ref a tag (recommended), branch or full commit; path the subdirectory ("" for the root); tag_prefix the prefix of its release tags.

path.description: Subdirectory in the repository ("" for the root).

cap_size.description: A size in K, M or G, such as 24G.
